crs: EPSG:4326 (vectors), rasters warped to EPSG:3857 for display, DEM kept in EPSG:25830

admin.title: Neighbourhoods, districts, municipality, urban centre
admin.source: OpenStreetMap admin_level 8/9/10 (via supplied GeoPackage, 23 Oct 2026); urban centre: European Commission JRC, GHSL Urban Centre Database 2025
admin.statistics: n_* counts and d_* per km² of facilities (snapshot), bus stops and buildings whose point/centroid falls inside each barrio or distrito; area_km2 ellipsoidal

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.assignment: each building stored once, in the 1 km cell containing its footprint centroid; loaders add neighbouring cells to cover footprints crossing cell edges

fields.lv: building:levels (floors above ground) — missing when not tagged

landuse.title: Land use
landuse.note: features are listed in every 1 km cell their bounding box touches; deduplicate by id

parks.title: Parks and gardens
parks.note: leisure=garden includes private gardens and courtyards (2,303 of 2,959 features)

fac_health.title: Healthcare facilities
fac_health.method: nodes, ways and relations with the listed tags; ways/relations as their centre point; one point per OSM feature

fac_education.title: Schools and education
fac_education.method: nodes, ways and relations with the listed tags; ways/relations as their centre point; one point per OSM feature

fac_stay.title: Hotels and tourist accommodation
fac_stay.method: nodes, ways and relations with the listed tags; ways/relations as their centre point; one point per OSM feature

contours_10m.title: Contours 10 m
contours_10m.extent: urban study mask (GHSL urban centre + 500 m)

places.title: Places and activities (Overture Maps)
places.source: Overture Maps Foundation — Places theme (file supplied by the user: overture-all-places-granada.geojson)
places.date: supplied 2026-10 (Overture release not stated in the file)

fields.cf: confidence 0–1 (Overture existence confidence; not a guarantee)
fields.dup: id of the first record with the same name and coordinates (5 decimals); duplicates are excluded from counts

places.caveat: Mapped places, not a census of businesses, people or activity. Counts are not population, footfall or economic vitality.

bus_service.title: Bus stops — scheduled service on 26 October 2026
bus_service.source: Stop-level service summary supplied by the user (granada_bus_frequency_2026-10-26.geojson), derived from a published timetable (GTFS); original feed and licence not stated in the file
bus_service.license: not stated in the supplied file — published at the user's request; confirm the GTFS licence

fields.trips_day: scheduled departures at the stop on the service date
fields.trips_7_9: scheduled departures in the window named "7_9" (07:00–09:00 by its name; the file does not define it)
fields.routes_count: number of routes serving the stop that day

bus_service.caveat: A dated schedule, not live tracking or ridership. Stop departures must not be summed into unique journeys. No scheduled service on this date does not mean the stop is closed.

trees_osm.title: Mapped trees (OSM snapshot)
trees_osm.caveat: Volunteered mapping, incomplete; absence on the map is not absence on the ground. No open municipal tree inventory was found.

buildings_lite.title: Buildings (simplified, neighbourhood scales)
buildings_lite.method: every footprint from the buildings layer, Douglas–Peucker 1 m per ring, coordinates rounded to 1e-5°; band (floor band) and period (start-date period) precomputed with the app's own rules; shown from zoom 12.5 until the full-detail tiles load (≥ 14.5)

flow_paths.title: Terrain-derived flow paths (approximation)
flow_paths.source: Computed in this repository from IGN MDT25 (25 m) — tools/build_flow.js
flow_paths.license: CC BY 4.0 — © Instituto Geográfico Nacional (input DEM)
flow_paths.method: priority-flood depression filling, D8 flow directions, flow accumulation; lines where the upslope area is ≥ 10 ha; classes 10–50, 50–250, 250–1000, ≥ 1000 ha
flow_paths.limitations: 25 m bare-earth model: no kerbs, gutters, drains, culverts, buildings or sewer network; filled depressions can route water across real barriers; not a flood or drainage model; upslope area counts only terrain inside the 20 × 20 km DEM square, so rivers entering from outside it (e.g. the Genil) are underestimated

urbanCentre.source: GHSL Urban Centre Database R2024 (GC_POP_TOT_2025, GC_UCA_KM2_2025) — modelled estimate for the whole urban centre

buildingFloors.method: median building:levels of buildings whose footprint centroid falls in each 50 m EPSG:25830 cell; grey hatched = buildings present but none with a floor count
buildingFloors.use: citywide views only (below zoom 12.5), cross-faded with the simplified footprints up to zoom 12.95

figureGround.method: scan-line fill of building footprints at 4 m per pixel; black = building

notes: "garnada highway paths.gpkg": 2868 lines, of which 2548 also appear (same OSM id) in "garnada highway.gpkg"; not loaded separately.

dem.type: Int16 little-endian, row-major from north-west, metres above sea level

slope.type: Uint16 little-endian, slope in degrees × 100 (Horn, gdal:slope on the 25 m DEM)

terrain.source: Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN), MDT25 — Modelo Digital del Terreno 25 m, catalogue epochs 2008–2015; regional 20 × 20 km extract and derivatives supplied by the user
terrain.vertical: metres above mean sea level (Alicante); integer values
terrain.note: Bare-earth terrain: buildings and bridges are not part of the model.

excluded: landuse garnada.shp/.dbf — duplicate of landuse garnada.gpkg (16,421 identical records) and missing .shx/.prj
schools.gpkg, health.gpkg (health1) — NUMPOINTS counts of mixed OSM nodes (gates, entrances, artworks) per barrio; not facility counts
schools points.gpkg, health.gpkg (health) — mixed node extracts; only 13 of 175 / 52 of 93 points are facilities. Replaced by the facility snapshot.
buildings. garnada points.gpkg, landuse garnada points.gpkg — node extracts (entrances, cameras, plaques); not used
boundary lines.gpkg — line version of boundary.gpkg plus unrelated ways
QGIS projects, QML styles, PDFs and HTML reports — kept private

built_100m.method: footprints clipped exactly to each 100 m EPSG:25830 cell (Sutherland–Hodgman). gsi = footprint area / cell area. far_est = Σ(footprint × building:levels) / cell area, given only where ≥ 80 % of the cell's footprint area has a floor count, otherwise null; an estimate, not measured floor area.
